situation: Coworker Raj asked me to take his on-call shift the weekend of Oct 17. I've already covered for him twice this quarter and that's my son's football tournament.
reply: I can see you need the weekend of the 17th covered. I can't take it this time, it's my son's football tournament. Elena mentioned last week she wanted extra on-call hours, so she might be worth asking.
note: The referral is only there because it is real; skip it if you don't have one.

situation: 表哥找我借5万说要做生意，之前借的2万到现在也没还。不想借，但他是我舅舅的儿子，不好撕破脸。
reply: 哥，你开口我知道不容易。这次我不借，我给自己定过规矩，亲戚之间不借钱，对谁都一样。你要是想找人一起把生意的账算一算，我可以陪你看看。
note: 用"规矩"而不是"没钱"，对方就没法在理由上讨价还价；之前那两万另找时间说，别混在这条里。

situation: A former client keeps asking me (graphic designer) to 'quickly' tweak his logo for free. I said no, now he's replied 'wow, after all the business I sent your way'.
reply: I understand you're disappointed, Greg, and I do appreciate the referrals. My answer's the same. If you'd like to book the tweaks, it's a one-hour job at $90 and I can fit it in this week.
note: After a guilt-trip, don't re-explain. State it once, keep the paid option, then stop replying on that thread.

situation: My mother-in-law, Carol, asked if we'll host Christmas again this year, 14 people. We've done it three years running and I'm worn out. Want to say no by text but still contribute something.
reply: Hi Carol, thanks for thinking of us. We're going to pass on hosting Christmas this year; after three years in a row we'd love a turn as guests. We're happy to bring the ham and the desserts wherever it ends up, and I can come early on the 24th to help set up. Love to you both.
note: A real smaller yes, the food and the setup, keeps the no generous. Don't nominate another host; that's her call.

situation: An ex-colleague, Josh, asked me to be a reference for a job at Carver Group; his final interview is Thursday. We only worked together on one project and honestly I wasn't impressed with his work. I want to say no without trashing him.
reply: Hi Josh, thanks for thinking of me, and congrats on getting to the final round at Carver. I'm going to say no to being a reference this time. We only worked together on the one project, so I couldn't give them the detail a strong reference needs. Priya, who managed you on the rollout, would do you far more good. Good luck on Thursday.
note: Declining a reference: give the true reason that doesn't judge the work, and point to someone better placed.

situation: Denise, the PTA chair at my kids' school, asked me to be treasurer this year. I've run the bake sale for 3 years, but I'm back at work full time now and I don't want a role with weekly hours.
reply: Thanks for thinking of me, Denise, I can see the treasurer spot needs filling. I'm going to say no to that one; with a full-time job this year I can't take on a role with weekly hours. I can still run the bake sale table on Saturday 7 November, if that helps.
note: A true reason that isn't up for debate, and a smaller yes that's real. Skip the offer if you don't actually want the bake sale either.

situation: 大学同学阿杰最近开始卖保险，约我吃饭时让我买一份年缴8000的重疾险，还让我把他推荐给我爸妈和表哥。我们关系一直不错，不想因为这个伤感情。
reply: 阿杰，谢谢你想着我，也看得出你对这份工作很上心。保险我就不买了，我给自己定了个规矩：不跟朋友买保险和理财，对谁都一样，这样朋友就只是朋友。我爸妈和表哥那边我也不帮忙介绍了，你别介意。下次吃饭我请，咱们聊点别的。
note: 用“规矩”拒绝，没法在理由上讨价还价；自己买和介绍家人两件事一次说清，不说“我考虑考虑”。

situation: My friend Jordan asked me to be the guarantor on his new apartment lease, $2,400 a month. I love him, but I don't co-sign anything for anyone. He's texting me and the lease signing is Friday.
reply: I can tell how much you want this place, and I'm glad you asked me straight. I'm going to say no to being your guarantor. I don't co-sign leases or loans for anyone, family included; it's a rule I keep so money never sits between me and people I care about. If it helps, I'm free tonight to help you ask the landlord whether a larger deposit could replace a guarantor before Friday.
note: A rule, not a comment on his finances, leaves nothing to argue with. Only offer the help tonight if you actually mean to give it.
